title: Download datasets from the HMP portal
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.srzed76

steps.title: Open sample page
steps.instruction: In a web browser, navigate to https://portal.hmpdacc.org/cases/YOUR_SAMPLE_NUMBER, replacing YOUR_SAMPLE_NUMBER with the desired sample ID (e.g., 3674d95cd0d27e1de94ddf4d2e0c0780 for 16S‑PP1 or 3674d95cd0d27e1de94ddf4d2ec63794 for WGS‑PP1).

steps.title: Review sample metadata
steps.instruction: Read the displayed information (body site, subject gender, study identifier) to confirm you have the correct sample.

steps.title: Add files to cart
steps.instruction: Click the ‘Add all files to the cart’ button in the top‑right corner of the sample page, then navigate to the cart.

steps.title: Identify desired files
steps.instruction: In the cart, locate the file types you need:

substeps.instruction: For 16S‑PP1 samples: raw dataset (raw_16s) in SFF format and trimmed dataset (trimmed_16s) in FASTA format.
For WGS‑PP1 samples: raw dataset (wgs_raw) in FASTQ format and assembled dataset (wgs_assembled) in FASTA format.

steps.title: Select appropriate sequencing run
steps.instruction: If multiple sequencing runs exist for the same sample, choose only one run—preferably the one with the largest file size. Also verify that the data type matches your project (e.g., avoid downloading a WGS run when you need 16S data).

steps.title: Copy download URL
steps.instruction: Because the ‘download’ button is non‑functional as of 08‑21‑18, click the file name to view its full URL, then copy the complete URL.

substeps.instruction: Example WGS raw file URL pattern: http://downloads.hmpdacc.org/data2/hhs/genome/microbiome/wgs/analysis/hmwgsqc/v2/SRS013951.tar.bz2
Example WGS assembled file URL pattern: http://downloads.hmpdacc.org/data/HMASM/IDBA/SRS013951.fna.bz2

steps.title: Download the file
steps.instruction: Paste the copied URL into a new browser tab or download manager and press Enter to start the download.
